cellular_Dirac.edge_complex: weighted square with RP3 and S1 edge directions
cellular_Dirac.finding: The canonical cellular Dirac square is exactly the weighted factor Laplacian already audited. It distinguishes labels but remains a commuting convolution operator.

determinant_line_values.data_type: one complex line/value for each spin structure
determinant_line_values.consequence: Eta invariants or determinant magnitudes can weight the three labels but do not define transition amplitudes between different spin structures.

classes.result: gauge-equivalent to the trivial commuting connection

connection_classification.finding: A determinant-line parallel transport adds no third topological option on the Z2^2 torsor: it is either trivial or the already-audited projective class.

pi_flux_cellular_test.finding: The magnetic cellular Laplacian has two doubly-degenerate levels and does not preserve the uniform-plus-triplet split.

spectral_flow_gate.edge_integers_or_phases: Spectral flow can orient or phase a chosen path between determinant fibers, but a graph of such paths is extra connection data.
spectral_flow_gate.closed_loop_content: Only the gauge-invariant plaquette holonomy survives vertex rephasings, reducing again to the trivial/projective dichotomy.

scientific_verdict.determinant_connection: returns either trivial transport or pi flux
scientific_verdict.no_go: None of the canonical spin-structure spectral constructions selects one of the twelve outside-D8 full-M3 incidence directions.
scientific_verdict.reopening_condition: A boundary theory must supply a non-flat, non-translation-generated graph connection with fixed edge magnitudes and sector assignment.
